target: DFLD-reported direction in the 30-minute bin starting at the valid forecast hour; not exact switch timing
timezone: Europe/Berlin, empirically checked against UTC METAR; not explicitly declared by provider
selection: Lowest validation Brier per horizon, never test tuning. Retain original fitted training coefficients for test and deployment.
baselines: frozen v1 direction model re-scored on identical actual-label test rows
challenge weather rules on identical archived weather, initialized from origin weather proxy
baselineRuleSteps: First future hour through valid time; aligned with browser, excludes origin step 0
dataAvailability: DFLD is a target only, never an origin feature. Origin METAR and fixed-offset archived ICON only; exact delivery timestamps unavailable.
deploymentRule: Deploy validation-selected direction models. Report all test outcomes, including regressions. Never alter closure coefficients or thresholds.
uncertainty: Paired daily-block bootstrap of test Brier differences, 1000 draws, fixed seed 20261030; retrospective uncertainty, not operational certification
